Thanks team — great turnout this morning ( ~420 registrants, ~180 live attendees ). I pulled the attendee export and attached the CSV; slides are also attached to the Drive link below.

Asking for two quick things so SDRs can start outreach by EOD Monday:
- Ava / Marissa: please confirm the MQL criteria below and mark the HubSpot list for SDR pickup.
- Diego: can you upload verified email bounces / unsubscribes to the same sheet (column: status) so we don’t route bad contacts to SDRs?

Routing suggestion (first pass):
- High engagement (asked Qs, clicked demo CTAs, >60% Watch): assign to SDR tier A (Marissa team).
- Product interest (requested pricing / integration): assign to SDR tier B (Ava).
- All others with company size >1000 and senior title: nurture via AE outreach in 2 weeks.

Attachments: attendees_export_20261128.csv, webinar_slides_redwood_keynote.pdf

Thanks Jordan — good notes. I ran the export against our engagement scoring and pushed a HubSpot static list (Post-Webinar - Acme Analytics - 11/28). Link below.

Quick updates / asks: 
- MQL criteria (final):
  - Engagement score >= 70 OR 
  - Watched >50% and clicked any CTA OR 
  - Identified as Product/Platform decision maker (VP+ or Head)
- Routing:
  - Tier A (immediate): HubSpot list filter: engagement >=70 AND company_size != Unknown -> assign to Marissa queue
  - Tier B (follow-up): watched >50% + pricing question -> assign to Ava queue
  - Nurture: all others -> add to nurture workflow A (2-week email + invite to on-demand demo)

I added assignment notes to the HubSpot contacts and created tasks: SDR teams have until EOD Monday to "claim" any contact in their queue. If not claimed, we'll move to the nurture flow.

HubSpot list: https://hubspot.company/contacts/list/8342
(Please do not delete: this feeds the SDR dashboard)

Attachments referenced: attendees_export_20261128.csv (I updated the engagement column), replay placeholder created at: https://streaming.host/replay/rdw-acme-20261128
